checks.reason: On each merged affine cell, convexity puts sup|d| at an endpoint. Integrating d^2 yields h(p^2+pq+q^2)/3; same-sign trapezoids and opposite-sign zero-split triangles yield the two L1 branches. Scaling p,q by their maximum preserves these formulas; normalizing by overlap width gives mean absolute and RMS.

Initial bisect brackets cover the clipped overlap; each next point is the minimum of both next knots and the overlap end. Exact equality advances both coincident pointers, distinct binary64 knots remain distinct, and strict greater-than maximum updates retain the earliest floating tie. No extrapolation or full union list is used.

Finite/ordered/shape validation, bounded convex interpolation, sign comparison without p*q, scaled integrals, and Neumaier sums match the contract. Nonfinite intermediate/result arithmetic is rejected. Ordinary binary64 cancellation, underflow, and range restrictions remain; no uniform relative-error guarantee or certified exact-real supremum is claimed. Extremely small squared integrals can underflow even when an unsquared norm would be representable.

Validation and merged traversal cost O(k(n+m)); only per-observable summaries/previous values/accumulators are retained beyond input arrays and output. C8 measured diagnostic auxiliary allocation, not whole-loader memory: 2088/2072 bytes for 2000/20000 knots, one observable. Whole standalone retains both loaded histories.

Actual receipt has required successful status, source relation, strict case checks, frozen checks and exact source/config/binding links. Loader uses identical log(a), ne/nH, nine FIELDS, and six saved Ybaryon arrays. Each required raw stream is parsed once with inline SHA256; small metadata is bound; ledger/checkpoint validation is reused without opening those files. Numeric alignment and clock prerequisites are rechecked. Missing/invalid required input produces HOLD with null metrics and nonzero CLI exit.
